page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1.xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance configured with 4 dedicated vCPUs and 32.0 GB of RAM. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz, the instance features 4 physical cores with 1.0 thread per core. The CPU architecture is x86_64, utilizing the KVM hypervisor. Cache specifications include 32 KB of L1d cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 35 MB of L3 cache. This instance does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and it operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 1 Gbps.

Benchmark results place the performance of the ecs.se1.xlarge in the lower tiers. The stress-ng single-core and multi-core CPU tests scored 1100.49 and 2931.93 respectively, both falling into the bottom 25% category. Memory bandwidth tests show a read-only small block cached speed of 163.82 GB/sec, while uncached large-block read-only bandwidth drops to 20.19 GB/sec, which is in the bottom 10%. PassMark CPU and memory scores also rank in the bottom 25%, indicating limited computational and memory throughput compared to modern hardware profiles.

Given the high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core alongside weak computational and database operation benchmarks, such as the PassMark database score of 1073.82 in the bottom 10%, this instance presents a clear tradeoff. It provides a dense memory allocation but exhibits low processing efficiency. It is suitable for memory-intensive workloads that do not require high CPU throughput, such as caching layers, lightweight in-memory databases, or basic web serving where memory capacity is prioritized over raw computational speed.
